templates_considered: admin_endpoints_check_role: fits AUTH-002; used, but scoped by api_groups ['admin'] instead of its tags ['admin'] because the workspace group has no tags
own_records_only: rejected; its compare_to $auth.id matches a per-user owner, but the ask is org-level and support staff must reach other orgs' tenants
endpoints_need_login, no_pii_in_responses, no_destructive_sql, get_endpoints_only_read: not relevant to the ask
no template for the tenants org_id filter: built AUTH-021 from db.where_constraint_required directly

rules.covers: every admin endpoint calls the role check before doing anything else
admin endpoints never touch tenants without an org_id filter

ask_parts_not_covered.part: role must be 'admin' or 'support_lead' (the decision itself)

assumptions: Role values and the test are in function check_admin_role (precondition on $user.role)
The tenants table is named 'tenants' with field 'org_id'
Support staff must be able to read tenants of other orgs, so the org filter is not compared to the caller's org
The check cannot see the role decision inside check_admin_role; it only checks the call is first
confusions: The skill says to scope by tag, not by name, but the workspace's admin API group has no tags and I may not change the workspace; the template's own example tags ['admin'] would have matched nothing here
No way to scope by URL path: an endpoint under /admin/ in another API group (app/admin/stats) cannot be selected, and the catalogue doesn't say so

Unclear whether db.get by field_name with no compare_to is judged by db.where_constraint_required at all; the description lists db.get as judged by its where, but db.get here uses field_name/field_value, so I inferred it is flagged
Unclear whether table_selector.names combined with field 'org_id' (vs 'tenants.org_id') changes which reads are judged; I used the bare field plus table_selector
No guidance on how a check that cannot verify the value (e.g. a hard-coded org_id) is treated; I assume any predicate on the field passes
wished_for: A path or URL-prefix scope for endpoints, so '/admin' can mean the URL prefix rather than an API group or tag
A template or worked example for a per-table tenant or org isolation rule, separate from the per-owner own_records_only template
A worked example showing a role-check precondition inside the called function, and what the check does and does not verify
Clear guidance on whether a policy can be verified with xano policy evaluate without publishing, so I could confirm my expected findings
why_confidence: Both policies parse cleanly and the role-first and org_id rules map to real checks. Confidence is held back because the /admin path gap (app/admin/stats) is not covered, the org filter only confirms a predicate is present not that it is correct, and my expected findings were not confirmed by evaluation (which I was not permitted to run).
